name: Chocochip Cookies
ingredients_raw: Refined wheat flour (maida), chocolate chips (21%) (sugar, cocoa solids, cocoa butter, dextrose, emulsifiers (INS 322, INS 476)), sugar, edible vegetable oil (palm), desiccated coconut powder, butter, milk solids, leavening agents (INS 500 ii, INS 503 ii), emulsifier (INS 322 from soy), iodised salt, artificial flavouring substance (vanillin).
